text: Arin stands quietly with both arms loose at his sides.
Arin folds his arms across his chest and waits.
Arin plants both hands on his hips.
Arin straightens up, heels together, arms at his sides.
Arin leans his shoulder against the wall.
Arin clasps his hands behind his back.
Arin rests his left hand on his hip, right arm hanging.
Arin turns away, showing his back to the room.
Arin takes the chair, feet on the floor and palms on his knees.
Arin sits on the stool and crosses one leg over the other.
Arin lowers himself to the floor, legs stretched forward.
Arin sits cross-legged beside the fire.
Arin sits on the floor and hugs his knees to his chest.
Arin perches on the edge of the bench.
Arin drops onto one knee, the other foot planted.
Arin settles onto both knees with his torso upright.
Arin kneels, joining his palms before his chest.
Arin sinks into a low squat, balancing over his feet.
Arin walks slowly across the courtyard.
Arin breaks into a sprint down the road.
Arin creeps forward with bent knees to stay unseen.
Arin leaps into the air, both feet leaving the ground.
Arin strides onward using his walking staff.
Arin raises his fists in a defensive fighting stance.
Arin swings his blade across his body.
Arin lunges forward, thrusting his sword.
Arin twists his body aside to dodge the blow.
Arin braces behind his raised shield.
Arin extends both hands, channeling a spell between them.
Arin raises one hand to cast, the other lowered.
Arin points toward the door with an outstretched arm.
Arin lifts his hand and waves to the departing boat.
Arin says, "Good morning."
Arin wonders whether he should sit later.
Mira runs past while Arin watches.
"Get down on one knee," Arin tells Mira.
Arin remembers the day he waved goodbye.
Arin does not raise his hands or cast a spell.
The empty chair creaks in the wind.
Arin describes how a fighter might block with a shield.
